name: PPC Packing Pending Report
query:
SELECT
  jc.name AS `Job Card:Link/Job Card Computer Paper:160`,
  jc.customer AS `Customer:Data:200`,
  jc.specification_name AS `Specification:Data:200`,
  jc.quantity_ordered AS `Cartons Ordered:Float:130`,
  jc.packed_cartons AS `Packed:Int:90`,
  (jc.quantity_ordered - jc.packed_cartons) AS `Balance Cartons:Float:130`,
  jc.loose_balance_sets AS `Loose Sets:Float:110`,
  jc.rejected_cartons AS `Rejected Cartons:Int:140`,
  jc.due_date AS `Due:Date:100`
FROM `tabJob Card Computer Paper` jc
WHERE jc.docstatus < 2
  AND (jc.job_status = 'Packing Pending'
    OR (IFNULL(jc.loose_balance_sets,0) > 0 AND jc.job_status NOT IN ('Closed','Cancelled')))
ORDER BY jc.due_date ASC
